description: Assets shipped with Mlola UI, read from source at build time. Kinds are open: 2D and 3D assets join as further entries with the same shape.

kinds.label: Icons
kinds.summary: currentColor SVG glyphs. Size and stroke follow the active theme unless a prop overrides them.

props.size: number or CSS length. Defaults to var(--mlola-glyph-size, 1.125rem).
props.strokeWidth: number or CSS length. Defaults to the theme's --ml-icon-stroke; --mlola-glyph-stroke overrides it.
props.title: gives the glyph an accessible name; without it the glyph is decorative

kinds.label: 2D assets
kinds.summary: Illustrations and spot art that follow the active theme.
